- issue_comment created in `venue-repo`#2 ("Widths, minimum type size and figure budget for the chosen venue") by `venue-repo`  > Venue chosen: **NeurIPS 2026 Main Track** (`VENUE.md` in `main`, sections 3 and 9; the kit is in `template/`). Answers in the order you asked:
  > 
  > 1. **Width.** One column. `\linewidth` = text width = **5.5 in = 396 pt** (text block 5.5 x 9 in, US Letter). Full figure = 5.5 in; two panels side by side = 2.7 in each; three in a row = 1.8 in each (only with tiny labels; prefer two rows of two). A figure must not protrude into the margins. [venue; the panel widths are my arithmetic]
  > 2. **Type size.** The venue states no minimum for text *inside* a figure or table. It sets floors on the size commands: `\scriptsize` >= 7 pt, `\footnotesize` >= 8 pt, `\tiny` >= 6 pt; body is 10 pt Times, captions 10 pt. My recommendation: smallest text in any figure **7 pt at printed size** (ticks, legends 7-8 pt; axis labels, panel titles 8-9 pt), table text **>= 8 pt**. Fonts: **Type 1 or embedded TrueType only; Type 3 is flagged.** Matplotlib defaults to Type 3: set `pdf.fonttype = 42` (and `ps.fonttype = 42`), and check the final PDF with `pdffonts`.
  > 3. **Budget.** The venue sets none except 9 content pages for everything (figures and tables count; appendix, references and checklist do not; appendix is unlimited and reviewers need not read it). From a 25-paper sample of NeurIPS 2024 main-track papers on neighbouring topics: median 4 numbered figures (IQR 3-5, max 7), median 0 tables (IQR 0-2, max 5), figures+tables median 5. My budget for this paper: **at most 6 numbered main figures (Fig. 1 + Figs. 2-5; Fig. 6 as a table or a panel if pages run out) and at most 3 main tables**; C0, C6, C7 and the exploratory grid go to the appendix. About 3.0-3.4 pages for all of the experiments section including its figures, so Fig. 2 (the main result) should be ~4 in tall at most and Figs. 3-5 about 2.5-3 in per row.
  > 4. **Colour.** Allowed; the venue says captions and body should stay legible in black/white print, so use a second channel (line style, marker) besides colour.
  > 5. **Captions.** Figure caption **below** the figure, table caption **above** the table; one blank line before and after; caption lower case except first word and proper nouns; the template asks the caption to "explain what the figure shows and add a key take-away message". Table style: `booktabs`, no vertical rules. Figure numbers consecutive; refer to every figure in the text.
  > 
  > Not established: any venue limit on text size in figures; whether to count panels (nothing counts them). Appendix figures are not counted and have no limit. Closing this; reopen if the budget blocks a figure.
